questions.subject: NP V
questions.topic: Concepts of Mental Health & Therapeutic Models
questions.stem: Who formulated the concept of the asylum as a safe refuge?
questions.rationale: Pinel and Tuke formulated asylum; Kraepelin classified disorders; Bleuler coined 'schizophrenia'.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Historical Perspectives (PDF p. 236)
questions.quote: Formulated the concept of asylum (safe refuge)

questions.subject: NP V
questions.topic: Concepts of Mental Health & Therapeutic Models
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Historical Perspectives (PDF p. 236)
questions.quote: Eugene Bleuler = coined the term schizophrenia.

questions.subject: NP V
questions.topic: Concepts of Mental Health & Therapeutic Models
questions.stem: What is the main tool of the psychiatric nurse?
questions.rationale: Therapeutic use of self, introduced by Peplau, requires self-awareness.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Therapeutic Use of Self (PDF p. 237)
questions.quote: Main tool used by the nurse in Psychiatric Nursing.

questions.subject: NP V
questions.topic: Concepts of Mental Health & Therapeutic Models
questions.stem: In Johari's window, qualities known to others but not to oneself are the:
questions.rationale: Quadrant II (blind) is known to others, not self; I open; III hidden; IV unknown.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Johari's Window (PDF p. 237)
questions.quote: Qualities known only to others, not to self

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: 'Is there something you'd like to talk about?' is an example of:
questions.rationale: Broad openings let the client take the initiative in choosing the topic.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Communication Techniques (PDF p. 237)
questions.quote: Allowing client to take the initiative in introducing the topic

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: 'Of all your concerns, which is most troublesome?' uses which technique?
questions.rationale: Focusing concentrates on a single point, useful when a client jumps between topics.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Communication Techniques (PDF p. 238)
questions.quote: Of all the concerns you have mentioned, Which

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: A hallucinating client says he hears voices; the nurse says, 'I hear no one else in the room.' This is:
questions.rationale: Presenting reality indicates what is real when the client misinterprets it.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Communication Techniques (PDF p. 239)
questions.quote: I see no one else in the room.

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: Client: 'Should I tell the doctor?' Nurse: 'Do you think you should?' This is:
questions.rationale: Reflecting directs the client's thoughts and feelings back to them.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Communication Techniques (PDF p. 239)

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: 'I will sit with you a while' is an example of:
questions.rationale: Offering self makes the nurse available unconditionally.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Communication Techniques (PDF p. 239)
questions.quote: I will sit with you a while.

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: 'I notice you are biting your lips' is an example of:
questions.rationale: Making observations verbalizes what the nurse perceives.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Communication Techniques (PDF p. 239)
questions.quote: I notice that you are biting your

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: 'What could you do to let your anger out harmlessly?' is:
questions.rationale: Formulating a plan of action helps the client plan for future situations.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Communication Techniques (PDF p. 238)
questions.quote: What could you do to let your anger out harmlessly?

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: 'Tell me whether my understanding agrees with yours' is:
questions.rationale: Consensual validation searches for mutual understanding of word meanings.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Communication Techniques (PDF p. 238)
questions.quote: Tell me whether my understanding of it agrees with yours.

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: 'What seemed to lead up to this?' is:
questions.rationale: Placing events in time sequence clarifies relationships between events.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Communication Techniques (PDF p. 239)
questions.quote: What seemed to lead up to?
